newsitem.title: USA: Nabors completes drilling assets purchase.
newsitem.headline: Nabors completes drilling assets purchase.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc on Thursday said it completed the purchase of the assets of privately owned Chesley Pruet Drilling Co for an undisclosed amount of cash.

The Chesley Pruet fleet consists of 10 active and two stacked rigs. Nine of the active rigs are diesel electric with drilling capabilities of 15,000 feet or greater. The active rigs are currently working or have immediate prospects for continuing work programs.

"We are experiencing escalating demand for this type of rig in Louisiana and Texas. The rigs and the large quantity of major component equipment and drill pipe included in the purchase will further our ability to meet our customer's needs for quality equipment to fulfill their increasingly complex drilling applications," Chief Executive Gene Isenberg said.
